segments.name: Power transmission equipment
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells marine and heavy-duty off-highway power transmission equipment to pleasure craft, commercial, military, energy and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Twin Disc designs, manufactures and sells marine and heavy-duty off-highway power transmission equipment.

revenueModel.text: Customers in marine, energy, government, military and industrial markets pay the company for its power transmission products, purchased through a direct sales force and a distributor network.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's worldwide sales to both domestic and foreign customers are transacted through a direct sales force and a distributor network.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company acquired Kobelt Manufacturing Co. Ltd., adding controls, propulsion, steering, and braking systems to its offerings.
changes.evidence: On February 14, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of 100% of the outstanding common stock of Kobelt Manufacturing Co. Ltd. ("Kobelt").
